name: Monthly Value Added Tax return
legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 31(1) — the tax period is one month ending on the last day of each calendar month, unless the Minister authorises another for a class of persons (s. 31(2)); s. 32(1) — a taxable person submits a return for each tax period within 20 days after its end; s. 32(2) — the return is in the form the Commissioner-General prescribes and states the tax payable, the output tax and the input tax; s. 25 — the tax payable is the output tax less the input tax credits. The form on TaxEase could not be opened from the machine this pack was written on: the rows below are this pack's own, grouped under those three figures, and the gap is recorded in this pack's README.

deadline.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 32(1) — within 20 days after the end of the tax period. Press reports on the Authority's notices of 2025 (VAT schedules submitted on TaxEase) give the 27th of the month; no text of the Authority's own states it, so the pack carries the Act's 20 days and flags the difference in its README. Penalties for late filing (2 % a month) are not modelled.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies — exports and international transport
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, Second Schedule, paragraph 1(a) and (b) — the value of exports and international transport. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies — local (Second Schedule)
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, Second Schedule, paragraph 1(c) to (q) — the value of local supplies taxed at nil. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Exempt supplies (First Schedule)
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, First Schedule — the value of exempt supplies. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Standard-rated supplies — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 24 — the sales on which the output tax is charged. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Output tax on standard-rated supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, ss. 25 and 32(2) — output tax on standard-rated supplies, net of credit notes given.

boxes.name: Imported services — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, ss. 3(c) and 16 — the value of an imported service on which the recipient pays the tax. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Output VAT on imported services
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 16(3) — the tax the recipient of an imported service declares and pays; included in output tax.

boxes.name: Total output tax
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, ss. 25 and 32(2) — total output tax: the tax on standard-rated supplies plus the reverse-charged tax of imported services.

boxes.name: Zero-rated purchases — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, Second Schedule — the value of local purchases taxed at nil. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Standard-rated local purchases — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 28(1)(a) — the purchases on which input tax is incurred. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Input tax on local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 28(1)(a) — input tax credit on local purchases, net of credits received.

boxes.name: Imports of goods — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, ss. 3(b) and 23 — the customs value of imports on which import tax is paid. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Input tax on imports
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 28(1)(b) — input tax credit on tax paid on imports of goods.

boxes.name: Total input tax
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, ss. 25 and 28 — total input tax credit: local purchases plus imports.

boxes.name: Tax payable or repayable
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2011, s. 25 — the tax payable: output tax less input tax credit. A negative figure is refunded to the taxable person under s. 47(1).
